_comment: HYDRA v1.0 DIP head — the complement. Single-coin (config.coin / HYDRA_COIN), LONG-only: buys a PULLBACK within a confirmed 4h uptrend (1h dipped or 1h RSI <= dipRsiMax), then rides the resumed move. Stands down whenever the 4h is not bullish — so it never knife-catches against the hedge head. One position per wallet. Pairs with the core + hedge heads on SEPARATE wallets, same HYDRA_COIN. Set wallet/strategyId/chatId (and HYDRA_COIN or coin). Runtime owns position tracking, caps, DSL via runtime-dip.yaml. Producer launched with HYDRA_LEG=dip.
_coin_note: This is the Hydra-ETH variant (HYDRA_COIN=ETH). hedge stressDropPct 8 — ETH-calibrated. One of three head wallets (core/dip/hedge); all three share this HYDRA_COIN. Same engine across all coins.
_role_note: DIP = the complement, gated to uptrends-only so it never opposes the hedge. It presses the thesis on the pullbacks the breakout-core misses; LONG only. dipRsiMax is the 1h-RSI threshold that counts as a real pullback. Fund default sizing: core 50% / dip 25% / hedge 25%.
_persona: Single-coin dip-buyer — long-only pullback catcher inside a confirmed uptrend, rides the bounce, time-cuts off. The complement head of a Hydra single-coin portfolio fund.
_v21_note: v2.1: requireDailyAlign (only dip-buy inside a 1d+4h confirmed uptrend) + dipRsiMax 42 (deeper, real RSI pullback, was 48). Stops the dip knife-catching chop.
